purpose: Positive control for external recording-key observability, added after initial lifecycle evidence without replacing it.
source_basis: Python eval_node uses get_recorded_value default nodes.record.out; C++ facade records eval_node::out then runs graph and returns/copies GlobalState. Verify rather than assume that the external scope exposes that buffer.
interpretation: If the positive capture is absent, empty-record presence is unobservable through this route and the earlier absence must not be attributed to recorder allocation. Silent-empty presence remains the prospective OP-11 expectation, not a post-observation repair.
